name: Bag BOM
description: Offline webcam label scanning and component selection for InteractiveHtmlBom.
description_full: Scan DigiKey and LCSC QR / Data Matrix labels to automatically highlight matching components in InteractiveHtmlBom. Barcode decoding and optional printed-text OCR run locally with bundled assets. Conflicting identities require manual selection. Experimental release; requires InteractiveHtmlBom separately. Apache-2.0.
